mentions.name: Peregrine
mentions.description: An integrated terminal and file browser with enhanced autocomplete and search, built to replace native OS terminals and file browsers. Also includes tailored OS utility features such as an advanced clipboard and a scratchpad.
mentions.source_excerpt: My integrated terminal + file browser with enhanced autocomplete and search. Replaces all native OS ones for me: https://github.com/David-OConnor/peregrine . Also includes misc utility OS functionality, tailored. (Advanced clipboard, a scratchpad etc)
mentions.author: the__alchemist
